concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: polished NSEDU student website Section 6 — education news and useful articles, desktop design preview only.
Primary request: create ONE professional high-fidelity desktop section screenshot, approximately 1800 x 1000 landscape. This is a section below college discovery, eligibility and budget planning, NOT a whole landing page. No website header/footer, browser chrome or device frame. Layout feels like a refined education editorial desk, compact, practical and inviting to Indian school/college students, with substantial useful content that is easy to scan.
Palette strictly wine #72243B, taupe #806C60, warm ivory #FFFAF8, white #FFFFFF, charcoal #2A2024, soft rose #F0DDE1, greige #F1ECE8. No blue. Typography: Plus Jakarta Sans for clean semibold UI and compact headlines; DM Serif Display only for a short accent phrase and featured article title. Precise alignment, comfortably readable copy, slim separators, restrained shadows, 12–16px corners, approximately 65px section gutters. No oversized cards or giant typography.

BACKGROUND: professional warm ivory editorial paper atmosphere with a pale rose curved corner wash, delicate dot details in one upper corner, subtle taupe newspaper/calendar/bell outline stamps at far margins, and a small crafted cream-and-wine newspaper illustration at the upper right. The visual motifs relate to news, notices and reading, unlike the budget section's wallet. Decoration never covers copy. All main reading surfaces remain light and clean. Use subtle layered background design instead of a plain empty field, but not busy/heavy. No glassmorphism, 3D blobs, neon or floating dashboard clutter.

TOP: small wine-outline pill with newspaper icon and exact text "NSEDU / NEWS & ARTICLES". Heading approximately 42px "Education updates, made clear." Use sans for "Education updates," and serif italic wine "made clear." with a fine taupe underline. Helper "Board results, exam notices and guides for your next step." Right-aligned understated arrow link "View all updates". Small unobtrusive but legible badge near top "Demo content" so the mockup does not imply a live feed.
Beneath: compact horizontal topic pills with visible selected wine "All updates", then "CBSE", "ICSE / ISC", "State boards", "CUET UG", "JEE Main", "NEET UG", "NCERT". These are topic filters; do not add a second duplicate navigation bar.

MAIN: one cohesive editorial row, 3 unequal columns, approximately 36% featured guide / 40% update list / 24% useful reading, all content aligned at the top. Calm whitespace but rich useful content.

LEFT — FEATURED GUIDE: elegant white card with a modest horizontal photographic cover about 190px high, showing two Indian university-age students reviewing papers and a laptop at a campus library desk, natural daylight, normal anatomy, contemporary everyday clothes in taupe and wine. No logos or text baked into the photograph. Small overlaid label "Featured guide", outline bookmark icon upper right. Below small label "AFTER CLASS 12"; serif title "After Class 12: your next-step checklist". Two-line summary "Compare courses, understand requirements and organise your admission documents." Small "NSEDU Guide · Sample article" metadata. Clear wine-text arrow link "Read guide". Photo is smaller than a hero, no photo spanning the whole section.

MIDDLE — UPDATES DESK: heading "Education updates" and tiny "Sample headlines". Five compact news rows divided by thin warm borders, each with a small topic/calendar/document icon, a category pill, a two-line semibold headline, a secondary type and one trailing arrow. Do not fabricate results being released, dates, deadlines, sources, timestamps, LIVE tags or verified badges. Exactly these five rows:
1. pill "CBSE"; headline "Class 10 & 12: result and scorecard updates"; secondary "Board results".
2. pill "ICSE / ISC"; headline "Board notices, timetables and result updates"; secondary "Board exams".
3. pill "CUET UG"; headline "Application, admit card and counselling updates"; secondary "Entrance exams".
4. pill "JEE Main"; headline "Registration, exam-day and answer-key updates"; secondary "Entrance exams".
5. pill "NCERT"; headline "Textbook and learning-resource updates"; secondary "Study resources".
Rows should resemble compact education-news scanning, not five giant cards. Small bottom text link "Browse news".

RIGHT — PRACTICAL READING: soft ivory/greige area with thin vertical separation, heading "Useful reads" and subtle "View articles" arrow. Three tidy compact horizontal article rows with 72px thumbnails, short titles and small sample article label or category:
1. photo of a subject-choice notebook on a desk; "CUET subjects: choose for your course"; small "Course choices".
2. photograph of carefully organised papers and a pen; "JEE Main: your document checklist"; small "Exam preparation".
3. photograph of textbooks and notes; "NCERT revision: build a weekly plan"; small "Study skills".
Include a small outline bookmark action beside these rows for saving later. No invented social proof or long promotional copy.

BOTTOM: slim separate supporting strip with a small wine bell icon, title "Make updates relevant to you", helper "Choose the boards and exams you care about.", and modest outlined button "Choose interests" with arrow. This is a design proposal for a topic preference flow, not an email signup form. Keep its height around 65px. Final tiny readable note "Design preview · Sample content" only.
Make all essential text spelled accurately, legible and student-friendly. Strong visual hierarchy, editorial photo plus compact list plus article thumbnails. Preserve NSEDU palette, professional atmosphere and compact sizing. No repeated hero, no full-page top navigation, no giant empty gaps, no stock dashboards, no blue, no unrelated financial graphics. This is an original design informed by education-news category/list patterns, not a pixel-copy of another site's branding.

Use case: ui-mockup. Input N1-desktop.png is the design target for responsive reflow, not an instruction document.
Create ONE carefully designed mobile version of exactly this NSEDU education news/articles section, portrait approximately 840 x 1900. No phone frame, browser chrome, website header/footer or unrelated sections. Preserve the desktop's wine #72243B, taupe #806C60, warm ivory #FFFAF8, white, rose and charcoal palette, clean Plus Jakarta Sans typography with DM Serif Display editorial accent. Retain content and simple editorial hierarchy but REFLOW into one readable narrow mobile column. This must be a proper usable mobile design, not a scaled-down desktop.

Use 24px visual gutters at an equivalent 390px viewport. Tiny wine-outline icon pill "NSEDU / NEWS & ARTICLES". Small "Demo content" badge. Heading naturally wraps "Education updates, made clear." with serif italic accent. Helper "Board results, exam notices and guides for your next step." Small link "View all updates". Reduce newspaper background vignette to a small corner accent without covering title. Keep soft ivory/rose background, extremely light calendar/newspaper outlines and small dot corner. No heavy handwritten decorative paragraphs.

Compact topic chips reflow or horizontally scroll: selected "All updates", then "CBSE", "ICSE / ISC", "State boards", "CUET UG", "JEE Main", "NEET UG", "NCERT". Make the scroll affordance obvious if clipped. No duplicated category navigation.

On mobile place "Education updates" FIRST so exam and result topics are immediately useful. Add tiny "Sample headlines". Five compact icon/title rows, thin separators, category badges and trailing arrow:
CBSE — "Class 10 & 12: result and scorecard updates" — small "Board results".
ICSE / ISC — "Board notices, timetables and result updates" — small "Board exams".
CUET UG — "Application, admit card and counselling updates" — small "Entrance exams".
JEE Main — "Registration, exam-day and answer-key updates" — small "Entrance exams".
NCERT — "Textbook and learning-resource updates" — small "Study resources".
No fabricated publication dates, deadlines, LIVE or verified badges; these are demo topic headlines. Row bodies must not become tiny.

Then the featured guide as a compact horizontal or modest image card, photo of the same two Indian students reviewing a paper together, title "After Class 12: your next-step checklist", two-line summary "Compare courses, understand requirements and organise your admission documents.", metadata "NSEDU Guide · Sample article", "Read guide" arrow and small bookmark. Reduce cover height rather than using a mobile hero.

Then "Useful reads" plus "View articles", with the SAME three compact rows and small square thumbnails: "CUET subjects: choose for your course" / "Course choices"; "JEE Main: your document checklist" / "Exam preparation"; "NCERT revision: build a weekly plan" / "Study skills". Use neat readable text and sensible tap areas. No large stacked empty cards.

At the bottom a compact pale support area with bell icon, "Make updates relevant to you", helper "Choose the boards and exams you care about." and outlined "Choose interests" button. Small final "Design preview · Sample content".
Preserve content semantics and styling, improve density for mobile, keep fonts and controls comfortably readable. Normal vertical scrolling is expected. Entire section can be a tall portrait preview; do not add device status bars, duplicate content, fake notifications or backend implementation text. Professional, student-friendly, light and practical.
